purpose: Measure Unsloth new-task collection yield before one reward update and independent research probes
initial_policy: Same producer-verified NF4 cache and native seed0 zero-B LoRA; fresh independent mechanism replication, not resuming the previously updated behavior batch
reward_group: Two distinct independently sampled focal actions from the same restored prefix, both completely verified, rewards0/1; original-action replay excluded
update: Once only on new behavior rows, after actual collection results are inspected; preserve actor old/reference and use measured native learner-old with sequence_tis cap2
validation: Four frozen train-pool research tasks; no focal data or gradients. Same adapter loading, seeds and budgets before/after a real update.
report: actor/learner probability differences and IS ESS
finite gradient and LoRA delta if updated
limitations: These tasks have existing S600 off-policy demonstrations. Independent within this VFARL round does not mean official heldout or never seen in pretraining/SFT.
continue_collected_batch: Mount the completed collection-only kernel and bind its root carrier/focal SHA. Preserve actor/tools/config/prevalidation sources; learner-only repairs retain both source hashes. Perform no new collection before the one update.

quota_allocation.reserve_purpose: 6h for update/independent probes plus4h for in-flight completion; actual quota remains authoritative
